name: Cripple
description: Wear down the legs. Enemies only. Speed -20% for 2 turns.

name: Hush
description: Silence a caster for a turn. Enemies only. Silenced (no skills) for 1 turn.

name: Dazzle
description: A flash that blinds. Enemies only. Blinded for 2 turns.

name: Sap Strength
description: The arm goes weak. Enemies only. Weakened (less physical damage) for 2 turns.

name: Itch Powder
description: The armour itches until the foe cannot stand it. Enemies only. Defense -15% for 2 turns.

name: Rubber Chicken Slap
description: Humiliating, and a little blinding. Enemies only. Blinded for 1 turn. Will -20% for 2 turns.

name: Weaken Armor
description: Rust and rot. Enemies only. Exposed (25% more damage) for 2 turns.

name: Stinging Mark
description: A mark that draws every blow. Enemies only. Marked for 3 turns. Resistance -15% for 3 turns.

name: Slow Venom
description: A venom that saps the legs too. Enemies only. Poisoned for 3 turns. Speed -15% for 3 turns.

name: Tar Trap
description: Sticky tar. One step, then none. Enemies only. Rooted (cannot walk) for 1 turn. The target loses 1 Move on its next turn.

name: Embarrassing Secret
description: Say it loudly. The foe loses heart. Enemies only. Attack -25% for 2 turns. Will -25% for 2 turns.

name: Banana Peel
description: Probably. 70% of the time, it works every time. Enemies only. 70% chance: Rooted (cannot walk) for 1 turn. Delays the target's next turn.

name: Mass Blind
description: A cloud of dust over every foe near the aim. Enemies only. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. Blinded for 2 turns.

name: Curse of Rust
description: Defences crumble. Enemies only. Defense -25% for 3 turns. Resistance -25% for 3 turns.

name: Choke Spores
description: Spores that silence and sicken. Enemies only. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. Silenced (no skills) for 2 turns. Poisoned for 2 turns.

name: Drain Spirit
description: Take the target's SP for yourself. Enemies only. Drains 5 SP for the user.

name: Lethargy
description: A heavy tiredness. Enemies only. Speed -25% for 3 turns. Delays the target's next turn.

name: Mime's Curse
description: The words will not come. Enemies only. Silenced (no skills) for 3 turns.

name: Witherblight
description: A blight that spreads over the area. Enemies only. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. Poisoned for 4 turns. Exposed (25% more damage) for 2 turns.

name: Hex Chain
description: A hex that binds voice, arm and mind. Enemies only. Silenced (no skills) for 3 turns. Weakened (less physical damage) for 3 turns. Magic -25% for 3 turns.

name: Paralyzing Gaze
description: A look that stops the foe cold. Enemies only. Rooted (cannot walk) for 2 turns. Delays the target's next turn.

name: Plague Cloud
description: A cloud of sickness over the area. Enemies only. Reaches every tile within 2 of the aimed one. Poisoned for 5 turns. Weakened (less physical damage) for 3 turns.

name: Soul Siphon
description: Take the SP and dull the mind. Enemies only. Magic -20% for 3 turns. Drains 10 SP for the user.

name: Doom Shroud
description: Everything near the aim is cursed at once. Enemies only. Reaches every tile within 2 of the aimed one. Exposed (25% more damage) for 3 turns. Silenced (no skills) for 2 turns. Rooted (cannot walk) for 1 turn. Poisoned for 4 turns. Weakened (less physical damage) for 3 turns.
